verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Bring to this table bread and wine
signs of redemption which God made divine
Soon gifts once humble shall become
God's pledge of salvation
Through Jesus his son

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Raise up your heart to our Lord present here
Give him the gift of your love
Join in this feast which unites man with life
And live with this peace in your heart

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Join in these offerings joys and cares
Be one with each other and all burdens share
Banish all hatred forgive every wrong
In Christ we are brothers
At peace we belong

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Soon in our presence Christ will
To lend us the courage which his victory won
Let hope enfold you trust in his care
Prepare to receive
Whose work we must share
